verdict: issues found and fixed in plan

attacks.attack: Executor edits six duplicated contact scripts inconsistently, fixing reset/demo behavior in some designs but leaving another design vulnerable.
attacks.defense: Original plan said to update all six and add a static test, but still left six security-sensitive implementations.
attacks.suggestedFix: Centralize the contact runtime in src/lib/contact-form.ts and make all six designs call the helper.

attacks.attack: Turnstile hostname validation remains ambiguous because the plan says likely taranity.com plus local/dev hosts.
attacks.defense: The original wording conveyed intent but not executable rules; an implementer could add localhost/wildcards to production.
attacks.suggestedFix: Define TURNSTILE_ALLOWED_HOSTNAMES as exact comma-separated lowercase hostnames with default taranity.com,www.taranity.com and no wildcards.

attacks.attack: Payload-limit fix overpromises because Content-Length may be absent and request.formData() can still parse a large multipart body.
attacks.defense: Original plan included Content-Length and field limits, but did not call out the residual platform-bound parse case.
attacks.suggestedFix: Document Content-Length as best-effort preflight and make post-parse server field limits authoritative.

attacks.attack: Renaming PUBLIC_WEB3FORMS_KEY can break the deployed contact form if the Cloudflare Pages runtime env is not updated.
attacks.defense: The original plan updated code/docs but did not include an operational deployment note.
attacks.suggestedFix: Record the required Cloudflare Pages runtime env rename in VERIFICATION.md and tests.

attacks.attack: Client-side tests could become unrun or fragile because Vitest is configured for node, not DOM.
attacks.defense: The original plan vaguely said client-side tests if practical, which invites either no coverage or dependency churn.
attacks.suggestedFix: Use static/runtime-structure tests for helper adoption/reset/DEV gating, and only add browser assertions if existing e2e works.
